subject.title: fix(llm): summarize ephemeral tool results to preserve prefix cache

question: Which tool-result visibility policy should OpenClaw use to protect DeepSeek prefix caching without hiding result-bearing tool outputs from the model?
rationale: The code can mechanically port or narrow the patch, but deciding whether heartbeat/status results are special, whether result-bearing tools need summaries, and how this interacts with the adjacent DeepSeek cache strategy is a provider/runtime product choice.

options.title: Require a targeted policy
options.body: Keep exec/read/web/memory-style result text visible and require any cache-safe placeholder behavior to be limited to owner-approved heartbeat/status results with live DeepSeek proof.

options.title: Sponsor broader summarization
options.body: Accept that some ordinary tool results may be hidden, but require an explicit design, tests for affected workflows, and upgrade/proof coverage before merge.

options.title: Pause in favor of cache-boundary work
options.body: Leave this PR blocked while maintainers decide whether adjacent prefix-cache work should own the broader DeepSeek cache mitigation instead.

recommendation.title: Require a targeted policy
recommendation.body: Keep exec/read/web/memory-style result text visible and require any cache-safe placeholder behavior to be limited to owner-approved heartbeat/status results with live DeepSeek proof.
